## Python Package Index


The following Python packages are installed into the released
`ghcr.io/nvidia/aicr-validators/aiperf-bench` image, which ships the AIPerf benchmark runner and its full
transitive dependency closure. The image is released for `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`;
the closure is resolved on `linux/amd64`, which is sufficient because a wheel's
architecture does not change its license, and the generator fails closed if
any dependency is gated to a single architecture.


Generated by `make python-licenses` from `<requirements>`
(sha256 `<redacted>`). Versions reflect the closure resolved at that time.


| Package | Version | License | Source |
|---------|---------|---------|--------|
| `britishspelling` | 3.0.0 | MPL-2.0 AND MIT | n/a |
| `declared` | 1.0.0 | Apache-2.0 | https://example.invalid/declared |
| `fenced` | 4.0.0 | HPND | n/a |
| `notext-pkg` | 6.0.0 | BSD-3-Clause | n/a |
| `prose` | 5.0.0 | MIT License | https://example.invalid/prose |
| `undeclared` | 2.0.0 | MIT | https://example.invalid/undeclared |
